ink.purpose: Page ground, canvas clear colour, input fill.

ink-2.purpose: Ground of floating layers only: command menu, mobile sheet, toasts.

haze.purpose: Calm horizon light in the scene and app header; selected command row.

haze-hot.purpose: Horizon light during a shock; header mixes haze to haze-hot by regime heat.

bone.purpose: Primary text, primary button fill, price thread, focus outline, pressed toggles.

bone-2.purpose: Secondary text, ledes, labels (8.3:1 on ink).

bone-3.purpose: Tertiary text, captions, key hints (5.9:1 on ink).

bid.purpose: Buy side, gains, match, calm regime dot. Data only.

ask.purpose: Sell side, losses, liquidation, invalid input. Data only.

pool.purpose: The on-chain AMM and arbitrage stream only.

shock.purpose: Shock state only: regime dot when hot, lambda, crash scar, regime bands.

grey.purpose: Scene particles far from the touch; never UI text.

rule.purpose: Hairlines between rows, badge outlines, tab baselines.

rule-2.purpose: Section rules above strips, control outlines, table header rules.

display.purpose: Landing hero title only; close and credit scale it further.

headline.purpose: Landing chapter titles and the gate title.

title.purpose: App page titles; landing stack words share the voice.

lede.purpose: One paragraph under a title, bone-2, max 34em.

subhead.purpose: Panel, toast and explain-region titles; sentence case.

label.purpose: Field labels and readout captions, bone-2.

button.purpose: Button and segmented labels; 16px at 52px, 19px at 68px.

numeral-big.purpose: Readout values, Apex scores, KPI values.

readout.purpose: Status line, numeric captions, Precise layer, scene labels, badges, code. The 12px floor.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system casts no shadows. Floating layers use ink-2 plus a rule-2 hairline.

atmosphere.name: vignette
atmosphere.purpose: Fixed over the scene on the landing.

atmosphere.name: film-grain
atmosphere.value: SVG feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.9, 2 octaves; opacity 0.07; mix-blend-mode overlay

atmosphere.name: horizon-header
atmosphere.value: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ink) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--haze-hot) <heat>%, var(--haze)) 100%)
atmosphere.purpose: App header light; heat 0 / 35 / 65 / 100 for calm / trending / liquidity drought / flash crash; 1s transition.

atmosphere.name: top-bar-fade
atmosphere.purpose: Landing top bar; no border, no blur.

atmosphere.name: scrim-bottom
atmosphere.purpose: Text-local scrim; left, right, centre and full variants exist.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Hover and press on controls, 0.2s; press moves 1px down.

motion.name: title-reveal
motion.purpose: Title lines revealed by a line mask.

motion.name: lede-reveal
motion.purpose: Ledes and controls after the title.

motion.name: scene-damping
motion.purpose: Camera and scene values ease continuously toward the chapter state.

motion.name: gate-boot
motion.purpose: Seed, book rise, camera descent, agents, then title and buttons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: One designed still, camera cuts, no reveals, no auto shocks; app transitions collapse to 0.001ms.

narrative.overview:
The market is drawn as the thing a quant already reads, a depth chart, extruded through time into a landscape: price runs left to right, resting size rises, time recedes to a horizon light. Every point in the scene is a resting order on a real price level; every rib is a one-second barrier; a crash is a wound that opens at "now" and flows into the past. The interface around that scene behaves like an instrument laid over film: black ink, warm bone type, and colour that only ever means data.

Density is bimodal. The landing and the gate are sparse and cinematic, with display-scale titles anchored bottom-left over the empty foreground and the scene owning the rest of the frame. The app (Arena, Agents, Benchmark, Proof) is dense and tabular, but speaks the same language: hairline-ruled strips instead of boxes, condensed mono numerals, a persistent terminal-style status line along the bottom edge. Depth comes from light (a horizon glow that heats with the market regime), a vignette and a static film grain, never from shadows or blur.

Confirmed rejections, all visible in what shipped: no headline-beside-a-visual hero, no free-floating starfield particles, no rounded dark cards, no navy-and-cold-white devtool palette, no purple, no gradients on text.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral black ink ground, warm bone text in three steps, hairline rules at two strengths.
Four data colours (mint bid, vermilion ask, blue pool, amber shock) that never touch chrome.
Archivo variable, expanded (wdth 122) for titles and normal width for text; Martian Mono, condensed, for every number.
2px radius on every control; nothing else is a shape.
Hairline instrument strips, not cards; one status line, not chips on the landing.
Light as depth: horizon glow, vignette, 7% film grain.

rules.name: The Data-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Mint, vermilion, blue and amber mean buy, sell, pool and shock, and nothing else. They never colour a button, border, glow or heading. If a colour is on screen, a number or a market object is behind it.

rules.name: The Words Carry It Rule
rules.body: Colour is never the only signal: liquidated rows are struck through and say so, matches say "match", the regime is a word beside its dot.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono sets numbers, hashes, identifiers, the status line, scene labels and the Precise layer. It never sets a sentence of prose longer than a caption.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 12px anywhere. (The hash rows' shrink below that on phones is decorative; the verdict carries the meaning.)

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Titles, buttons, labels and status words are sentence case. Titles use `text-wrap: balance`; ledes and body use `pretty`.

rules.name: The Light Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If a layer must float, give it ink-2 and a rule-2 hairline; if a region must feel hot, change the horizon light.

rules.name: The Scrim Is Local Rule
rules.body: Text on the scene sits on a scrim shaped to that text block. The scene is never hidden behind a full-width panel.

dos: Do set every number, hash and identifier in Martian Mono with tabular figures at wdth 87.5 (wdth 80 for big numerals).
Do keep chrome in bone, bone-2, bone-3 and the two rules; reach for mint, vermilion, blue or amber only when a market value or object is shown.
Do build app surfaces as hairline-ruled strips: one rule-2 line on top, a 13px subhead, content on the ink ground.
Do use 2px corners on every control and nothing larger.
Do put text that overlaps the scene on a local scrim shaped to that text.
Do show focus as a 2px bone outline at 3px offset.
Do keep the 12px text floor and sentence case everywhere.
Do honour reduced motion: the scene renders one designed still and the camera cuts between states.
donts: Don't put a data colour on a button, border, glow or heading.
Don't use shadows, backdrop blur or rounded cards; floating layers get ink-2 and a hairline.
Don't set prose in mono or titles in all caps.
Don't use purple, navy-and-cold-white, or gradients on text.
Don't scatter free particles or decorative graph edges in the scene; every point is an order on a level and every edge is a real agent-to-venue relation.
Don't place a headline beside a decorative visual; titles sit over the scene's foreground.
Don't add arrows to buttons or decorate any button except "Crash the market" with its amber dot.
